title: Prepare and qualify a concrete release candidate
actor: A release maintainer preparing reviewed product work
goal: Obtain an identifiable qualified candidate and concise review basis without manual duplication of release facts or publication side effects.
context: The product changes and compatibility decision have been reviewed, but the actual release candidate has not yet been established.
trigger: The maintainer or supported routine operation selects the reviewed release intent.
preconditions: The intended version/source, supported profile, and required local inputs are identified.

interaction.action: Supplies or selects the existing reviewed release and version decision.
Presents prepared profile-owned outputs, scope and ownership diagnostics, and actual qualification results for the exact candidate.
Provides the retained candidate identity and check summary when all required non-deferred obligations are established.

expected_outcome: The maintainer receives a reviewable exact candidate whose actual checks, generated expectations, permitted source differences, and remaining limits are explicit; no preparation action publishes it.

alternatives.condition: Preparation is rerun on the same complete basis.
alternatives.outcome: The same permitted projections are produced while human narrative and historical observations remain intact.

failures.condition: Version intent, profile, required artifact, current literal ownership, or qualification evidence is missing or conflicting.
failures.outcome: The system reports the precise defect and does not present the candidate as ready for publication.

failures.condition: The request requires unsupported historical replay or a new unresolved product/publish-mechanics decision.
failures.outcome: It stops before generation or publication at the named owner boundary.

failures.condition: An already published unchanged version is selected.
failures.outcome: The attempt is identified as a no-op, duplicate, or recovery case without overwriting publication.
